# SEO-055: List only canonical URLs in the sitemap

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Domain | `canonicals` |
| Category | `TECHNICAL_SEO` |

| Evidence tier | `A` |
| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

Every entry in a sitemap is an address that declares itself canonical; alias URLs, redirecting URLs, and parameter variants do not appear as entries.

## Rationale

A sitemap is a statement about which addresses the site wants processed, so listing a non-canonical variant contradicts the canonical declaration and spends the crawl the submission requested on a URL that will be discarded.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_sitemap"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Generate sitemap entries from the same route inventory and URL builder the canonical uses, filtering out anything the inventory marks as an alias or a redirect source. Regenerate rather than hand-editing entries.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: For each sitemap entry, request the URL and confirm the canonical it declares is the entry URL itself.
- Evidence: `SITEMAP`, `RENDERED_HTML`, `HTTP_STATUS`
- Automated check: `sitemap-canonical-only`

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `BING_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
